tips.text: Run the highest vault tier you have unlocked; each Necramech there drops a matrix of that tier.
Bring Nekros with a Resource Drop Booster; matrices are enemy drops, so Desecrate and the booster both apply.
Add a companion with Resourceful or Loyal Retriever to double matrix drops.
Join a Sporothrix or Arum Spinosa group that chains vaults; matrices and damaged parts pile up without organizing runs.
Bank each tier's matrices before the rank-up; spending standing on wares first delays it.
Buy the three barrel blueprints from Father early and set them aside before you hit the daily standing cap.
Queue all four components at once so you wait one 12-hour timer.
Build Voidrig first if you want both Necramechs; it builds the Necraloid ranks and matrix stock once, and Bonewidow then adds mostly mining.
Expect the matrix sacrifices to stall you, not the standing; each rank-up wants a different vault tier.
Expect Namalon to be the longest part; players rate the Bonewidow grind worse than Voidrig's.
